cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold the lantern for now. Wear the badge; you're still the Keeper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you appoint a successor. Find one who'll take both the badge and the lantern.

reason: A takes back the immediate physical burden while the title still binds B to recruitment and ceremonial handover; replace probation rhetoric with an actual accommodation.
